chars.AMMAR: AMMAR: a slim prison guard wearing a dark olive-green guard uniform shirt with a bright yellow shoulder patch, dark green trousers, a black belt with keys and a black peaked cap on his head
chars.RACHID: RACHID: a sturdy prison inmate wearing a bright orange hooded sweatshirt, faded blue jeans and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan prison courtyard with high beige walls, RACHID leans in and quietly talks to two other inmates in grey tracksuits who shake their heads and turn away; RACHID looks disappointed.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small prison cell, RACHID sits on a metal bunk bed, elbows on knees, staring at the floor deep in thought, worried, dim light from a barred window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a prison corridor, RACHID glances suspiciously over his shoulder at other inmates walking past, narrowed eyes, tense posture.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: RACHID stands in his cell, staring anxiously out of a small barred window as the sun goes down, hand on the back of his neck, nervous.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the bars of a prison cell, RACHID leans close and whispers to AMMAR who stands outside the bars in the corridor, AMMAR listens surprised, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close two-shot at the cell bars: RACHID leans toward AMMAR with a confident sly smile, making a big persuasive gesture; AMMAR jerks back in shock, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AMMAR in his uniform stands on a quiet street of a small Moroccan town at sunset, dreamily looking at a nice new white house with a green door, imagining a better life for his family.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night outside the prison gate under a single street lamp, AMMAR stands alone with his cap in his hand, torn and hesitant, staring into the distance, long shadow.
